@ed@tanous.net @rushtotom@gmail.com @rohitpai77@gmail.com Please help with the review

I'm not seeing anything in those that would say that it's required the two URIs be separate?

I do see that all the redfish examples use update-multipart, so keeping that the same makes sense to me.

In the Redfish FW Update White Paper, we can see two different URIs- one for Multipart Push update(Section 3.1.2) and and other for Unstructured HTTP Push update (Section 3.1.3).  (https://www.dmtf.org/sites/default/files/standards/documents/DSP2062_1.0.2.pdf)

Since the Unstructured HTTP Push Update endpoint is marked as deprecated, shall we think about deprecating that endpoint and allow fw update only when content type is multipart/form-data ?

> shall we think about deprecating that endpoint

I'm not sure what that means, but there's certainly a lot of client code that still uses the "deprecated" one, and it's trivial to continue to support.
Ahh, got it.
I'm not sure how far we want to go trying to get the commit message perfect here, but the justification of matching the spec examples makes sense to me.
So we are basing this off the spec examples? Let's add that to the commit msg.
Yeah, spec examples use a separate URI named update-multipart.  Rajeev, please update your commit message.
Acknowledged
